commands.start: Engage auto; does not restart already active cycles.
commands.stop: Close auto gates, stop v5 and fade all gains to zero in 20 ms.
commands.bypass: Close auto gates, stop v5 and return all gains to unity in 20 ms.
commands.restart: Engage auto and restart all twelve cycles.
commands.range <min_ms> <max_ms>: Each value is clamped to at least 1 ms and sorted; affects future rising legs.
commands.waittime <ms>: Nonnegative hold; consulted when a falling leg ends.
commands.fixedpeak <0|1>: 1 = future peaks at unity; any other value = random peaks.
commands.grain <ms>: Integer 1–1000; v5 update interval and signal interpolation time.

automixer.alloff: The existing ADSR_12_Lanes_Stop_v20 bus changes active Auto to Stop. Bypass remains bypass.
automixer.position: Post-matrix, before named spatial buses, DAC-fader feeds and mono FX sum.
